'''Marimaru''' (Japanese: '''マリ丸''' ''Mali-Maru'') is a Marill who appeared in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. She is [[Apricot]]'s ninja partner, with both of them training under Marimaru's mother, [[Madam Azumarill]].
